narr: In the late afternoon of the 20th, a cluster of storms began to from in north central Colorado and moved east. As the evening progressed, this cluster grew into more of a line. This line of storms produced up to four inch diameter hail, accumulating hail up to a foot deep, 75 MPH wind gusts, and heavy rain. The combined effect of accumulating hail and heavy rainfall led to street and basement flooding in Yuma.
ev: Spotter reported street flooding and basements being flooded in Yuma. Pictures from other sources show hail accumulating to around a foot deep. The combined affects of deep hail and heavy rainfall likely overwhelmed the storm drains, preventing the heavy rainfall from draining away. Unclear how many basements were flooded, or how much damage was caused by the flooding.
lsr: Spotter reported that streets and basements are flooding in the city of Yuma at 10:15 pm MDT.
